translations.dataNotice.title: Before you start: your data
translations.dataNotice.recorded: While you work, TutorIA saves your code, the conversation with the tutor, the tests you run, the hints you ask for, when you paste code and when you leave the workspace.
translations.dataNotice.never: {$START_TAG_STRONG}It never records the audio{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG} of your voice.
translations.dataNotice.purpose: Your teacher and the TutorIA administration see it, to know when to help you and to improve the activities, not to penalise you.
translations.dataNotice.ai: So that the tutor can answer you, an external artificial intelligence provider receives the statement, your code and the conversation, but not your name or your email.
translations.myData.heading: Recorded data
translations.myData.intro: What TutorIA records while you work, what for and who can see it.
translations.myData.never.audio: The audio of your voice: TutorIA neither records nor keeps it.
translations.myData.never.detail: When you talk to the tutor, only the text is kept, and you can check it before sending it. Nor is anything you do outside TutorIA recorded.
translations.myData.purpose.text: To learn, not to penalise: it helps your teacher know when to come over and give you a hand, and improve the activities.
translations.myData.viewers.text: Your teacher, only in the groups they are in charge of, and the TutorIA administration.
translations.myData.viewers.others: Other students do not see your data.
translations.myData.services.ai: The tutor's answers are written by an artificial intelligence model from an external provider. It receives the statement, your code, the conversation and the hint level, but not your name or your email.
translations.myData.services.voice: When you use your voice, your browser does the recognition and may send the audio to an external service to transcribe it (Chrome, to Google). If you would rather avoid it, you can always type.
translations.myData.recorded.time: When you work on each exercise
translations.myData.recorded.time.detail: When you start, save, run the tests and submit.
translations.myData.recorded.code.detail: It is saved automatically as you type, so you do not lose it and your teacher can see it.
translations.myData.recorded.runs.detail: How many tests pass and which ones fail.
translations.myData.recorded.hints.detail: How many and at what level.
translations.myData.recorded.chat.detail: The text of what you write and of what it answers, also if you ask for the solution.
translations.myData.recorded.paste.detail: When you paste text into the editor, and how much.
translations.myData.recorded.away.detail: When you switch tab or window and how long you are away, but not where you go.

translations.settings.reactions.intro: The animations the tutor adds to its answers.
translations.settings.reactions.emojis.hint: They move with the reaction. Without them, the same emoji standing still, lighter for slow connections.
translations.settings.reactions.try.hint: Each try changes the reaction and its intensity. In the chat, the tutor picks the intensity to suit the moment.
translations.settings.tutor.proactive: The tutor may write to me on its own
translations.settings.tutor.proactive.hint: If you have been stuck for a while or you get past something that was resisting you, it writes without you asking.
translations.settings.tutor.voice: Talk to the tutor by voice
translations.settings.tutor.voice.hint: Soon you will be able to talk to it and hear its answers. The audio is never recorded.
translations.settings.privacy.text: What TutorIA records while you work, what for and who can see it.
translations.settings.reactions.full.hint: Emoji, confetti and effects for 2 to 3 seconds.
translations.settings.reactions.reduced.hint: Just a small emoji, with no effects around it.
